name: API client (token, calls, streams)
description: What every AXF web app needs to talk to its own server: the app's token in localStorage (every access wrapped, change event), Bearer call/post/put/patch/del with ApiError (message + HTTP status) and the standard 401/404 messages, file download and token-protected blobs, and a TokenDialog built from the framework's React controls and theme classes. Server-Sent Events come from framework/core/sse.ts (readSse, followSse with back-off). Harvested Oct 2026 from the Dev Console, its plugins and Build Pilot.

params.label: Token storage key
params.help: localStorage key the app's token is kept under (the console uses axf-console:token).

placeholders.note: Android port (token in the platform SecureStore, OkHttp calls through axf-network) — not built; Android apps use axf-network directly.
Token refresh / OAuth sign-in — not built; bearer tokens pasted by a person only.
